failed_or_abandoned: First version integrated the ROI only above 5.4 keV and used P050's erf turn-on (sigma 2.5 keV), which set the 8B count to zero by construction while implying 45 8B events with the efficiency alone; replaced by full-range integration with a turn-on width calibrated on LZ's 0.057 8B+hep events (sigma_lo = 0.74 keV).

First flux central (gamma_b = 2.0, E2 = 1.5 GeV) gave dPhi/dE(1 GeV) = 4.5e-4 cm^-2 s^-1 MeV^-1, x2 above the recalled Honda value; re-centred to gamma_b = 2.3, E2 = 2 GeV (old central kept as the 'hard mid' variant).
Asimov Z formula rejected for the discovery limit because it returns Z = 3 for ~0.5 events when b ~ 1e-4; exact Poisson with n_crit staircase used instead.
